title: Zelle
description: Zelle's official style guide defines the primary colours Zelle Purple (#6D1ED4, PMS 266 C) and White (#FFFFFF), the secondary colours Indigo (#2A105F), Light Purple (#815DFF) and Light Gray (#EFEFEF), and the accent colours Mint (#5BDDB4), Lilac (#CCCCFF), Dark Purple (#471E99) and Cool Grey (#939598).
